title: Net Cord Believer
style: electronic dance pop, 124 BPM, four-on-the-floor, sparkly synths, big drop chorus, anthemic male vocal, hands-up festival energy, hopeful
lyrics:
[Intro]
Tape kissed the ball and the ball said yes
Off the cord, off the cord, what a mess

[Verse 1]
Two-two, deuce, my paddle's shaking
Sun in my eyes and my knees are aching
Lifted a roller, didn't mean to do it
Hit the white tape and the world went through it

[Chorus]
Net cord believer, lucky little dancer
Tape ball talker, gravity's the answer
Net cord believer, won the point I shouldn't
Said sorry with my hand and we both knew I wouldn't

[Verse 2]
Partner laughed, opponents groaned
Universe rolled the dice I owned
Ten percent skill and ninety percent prayer
Pickleball gods don't play fair

[Chorus]
Net cord believer, lucky little dancer
Tape ball talker, gravity's the answer
Net cord believer, won the point I shouldn't
Said sorry with my hand and we both knew I wouldn't

[Bridge]
Apologise with the paddle up
Same trick tomorrow if I'm lucky enough

[Outro]
Tape kissed the ball and the ball said yes
